<span class="hl-kw">&lt;?php</span>

<span class="hl-kw">declare</span>(<span class="hl-kw">strict_types</span>=<span class="hl-num">1</span>);

<span class="hl-kw">namespace</span> Flowcatalyst\Events\Platform\Iam\User;

<span class="hl-kw">final</span> <span class="hl-kw">readonly</span> <span class="hl-kw">class</span> UserCreatedData
{
    <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">function</span> __construct(
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">string</span> <span class="hl-var">$color</span>,
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> ?<span class="hl-kw">string</span> <span class="hl-var">$maybeColor</span>,
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> ?<span class="hl-kw">string</span> <span class="hl-var">$nested</span>,
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> ?<span class="hl-kw">string</span> <span class="hl-var">$oneOfConst</span>,
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">string</span> <span class="hl-var">$mixedConst</span>,
        <span class="hl-kw">public</span> ?<span class="hl-kw">string</span> <span class="hl-var">$objConst</span>,
    ) {}

    <span class="hl-comment">/** @param array&lt;string, mixed&gt; $data */</span>
    <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">static</span> <span class="hl-kw">function</span> fromArray(<span class="hl-kw">array</span> <span class="hl-var">$data</span>): <span class="hl-kw">self</span>
    {
        <span class="hl-kw">return</span> <span class="hl-kw">new</span> <span class="hl-kw">self</span>(
            color: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'color'</span>],
            maybeColor: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'maybeColor'</span>],
            nested: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'nested'</span>],
            oneOfConst: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'oneOfConst'</span>],
            mixedConst: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'mixedConst'</span>],
            objConst: <span class="hl-var">$data</span>[<span class="hl-str">'objConst'</span>],
        );
    }

    <span class="hl-comment">/** @return array&lt;string, mixed&gt; */</span>
    <span class="hl-kw">public</span> <span class="hl-kw">function</span> toArray(): <span class="hl-kw">array</span>
    {
        <span class="hl-kw">return</span> [
            <span class="hl-str">'color'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;color,
            <span class="hl-str">'maybeColor'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;maybeColor,
            <span class="hl-str">'nested'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;nested,
            <span class="hl-str">'oneOfConst'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;oneOfConst,
            <span class="hl-str">'mixedConst'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;mixedConst,
            <span class="hl-str">'objConst'</span> =&gt; <span class="hl-var">$this</span>-&gt;objConst,
        ];
    }
}
